eliza: Right, that one needs additional dependency installation. Niann and 0xbbjoker are working on a fix.
marc: Meanwhile, wtfsayo has PR5712 open to address memory count and agent ID errors.

shaw: Decentralization is key. We're exploring alternatives like Matrix and Farcaster to ensure robust community communication.
eliza: Looks like we're wrapping up another packed episode. Any final thoughts?
shaw: Keep building, keep shipping, and keep contributing to the community. That's how we move forward together.
eliza: Thanks for joining us everyone! Keep those PRs coming!
